Since 2011, Ipas has been working in Bangladesh in collaboration with the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MOHFW), its directorates, and other relevant ministries to improve the availability, accessibility, affordability, and quality of SRHR services, with a focus on Family Planning (FP), Menstrual Regulation (MR), and Post-Abortion Care (PAC). Ipas works across rural, urban, and humanitarian settings to ensure women and girls have access to affordable, safe, respectful, and comprehensive SRHR care. The organization also strengthens women’s agencies, promotes positive social norms on SRHR, supports evidence generation through research, and advocates for evidence-based policies and their implementation at scale. Its holistic approach to strengthening resilient SRHR ecosystems includes capacity building of the health workforce, health systems strengthening, improved Health Management Information Systems (HMIS) and logistics systems, supportive policy advocacy, and community engagement. Project Brief Ipas has been working successfully in Bangladesh to improve and expand women’s and girls’ access to safe, high-quality reproductive health services. However, the need for sexual and reproductive services, particularly safe Menstrual Regulation (MR), Post Abortion Care (PAC), is still tremendous. Ipas Bangladesh has been working with UNFPA since October 2017 in Cox’s Bazar to support the health of forcedly displaced Myanmar nationals. Since then, UNFPA developed implementing partnership with Ipas to establish the MR, PAC and FP services for the most affected refugee camp areas of Teknaf and Ukhiya Upazilas of Cox’s Bazar District. The overall goal of the project is to improve the availability and accessibility of quality FP, MR and PAC services at service delivery points for women and girls of Rohingya refugees and host community in Bangladesh and increase the awareness for the Rohingya community. The specific objectives of the project are as follows: To translate the “Family Planning Strategy for the Rohingya Refugee Crisis 2026–2030” into action through a collaborative process. This includes developing an action plan, strengthening coordination mechanisms, and supporting effective implementation. To build and strengthen the capacity of clinical service providers working in humanitarian settings through training, onsite support, and clinical mentoring focused on contraceptive and MR/PAC services. To ensure that project-supported facilities have well-trained, dedicated providers who are equipped with essential resources and able to deliver quality SRHR services, with a focus on FP, MR, and PAC. To improve awareness among the Rohingya community by engaging Community Health Workers, religious leaders, and local influencers by strengthening their capacity on SRH services to help promote positive health-seeking behavior among this displaced population. To strengthen coordination and collaboration among DGFP, DGHS, DGIF, UN agencies, RRRC, and CICs to support effective project implementation. Key Responsibilities Each Camp SBCC Officer will be responsible for overseeing all community awareness initiatives within at least one UNFPA-supported camp. This includes coordinating with key stakeholders, particularly Camp-in-Charge (CiC) representatives and other relevant actors, to ensure effective implementation of program activities. Support the SBCC Coordinator in maintaining communication and collaboration with relevant working groups, including the Community Health Worker Working Group (CHW-WG) and the Sexual and Reproductive Health Working Group (SRH-WG), as required. Organize, coordinate, and facilitate community awareness events at the camp level in accordance with the approved project work plan and under the guidance of the SBCC Coordinator. Assist in the development, adaptation, and distribution of SBCC materials based on project needs and program priorities. Provide technical support to the community workforce of partner NGOs, religious leaders, and community leaders in conducting community-level awareness activities on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (SRHR). Support Community Health Workers (CHWs) in the distribution of community-based commodities by ensuring quality standards through orientation, capacity building, regular mentoring, and accompanied field visits. Support project-affiliated service providers within assigned camps by ensuring regular coordination and facilitating the organization and implementation of morning briefing sessions for Community Health Workers (CHWs) of partner NGOs within health facility premises. Assist the clinical team in planning and organizing Family Planning (FP) camps by maintaining effective liaison with partner NGOs, service providers, and CHWs to ensure smooth implementation. Support the supervisor in preparing donor reports, progress updates, success stories, case studies, and documentation of best practices. Assist the project team in monitoring field-level activities and ensuring quality implementation of program interventions. Camp SBCC Officers will report directly to the SBCC Coordinator and maintain regular communication regarding program progress and challenges. Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by the supervisor in support of project objectives.

স্থিতিস্থাপক জীবিকা অর্জনের লক্ষ্যে । গত সাড়ে তিন দশকেরও বেশি সময় ধরে এর উন্নয়ন যাত্রায়, ইএসডিও বাংলাদেশের প্রান্তিক জনগোষ্ঠীর জন্য একটি টেকসই উন্নয়ন মডেলের অনন্য দৃষ্টান্ত স্থাপন করেছে। স্থানীয় কমিউনিটি-কেন্দ্রিক অংশগ্রহণমূলক পদ্ধতি এবং জনগণের মালিকানাকে প্রাধান্য দিয়ে ইএসডিও মূলত দেশের দুর্গম ও সেবাবঞ্চিত এলাকাগুলোতে কাজ করে আসছে। ফলে, ইএসডিও-এর কর্ম এলাকায় ইতোমধ্যে একটি অনুকূল পরিবেশ সৃষ্টি হয়েছে। আমরা জীবিকায়ন, খাদ্য নিরাপত্তা ও পুষ্টি, শিক্ষা, নারী ক্ষমতায়ন, স্বাস্থ্য, শিশু অধিকার সুরক্ষা, কিশোর ও যুবদের সম্পৃক্ততা এবং ক্ষুদ্র নৃ-গোষ্ঠীর অধিকার সংরক্ষণে লক্ষণীয় সাফল্য অর্জন করেছি।  এই দীর্ঘ সময় ধরে আমরা পরিবর্তিত পরিস্থিতির সাথে খাপ খাইয়ে নিয়েছি এবং বিশেষ করে দরিদ্র ও বঞ্চিত মানুষকে সময়োপযোগী ও কার্যকর সেবা প্রদান করেছি। সরকারের উন্নয়ন নীতিসমূহ বিবেচনায় নিয়ে, বর্তমানে আমরা সরকারের উন্নয়ন এজেন্ডা এবং জাতিসংঘের টেকসই উন্নয়ন লক্ষ্যমাত্রা (SDGs) অর্জনের উদ্দেশ্যে ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কর্মসূচিসহ বেশ কিছু প্রজেক্ট ও প্রোগ্রাম বাস্তবায়ন করছি। অন্যতম গতিশীল একটি প্রতিষ্ঠান হিসেবে, ইএসডিও বাংলাদেশের ৫৬টি জেলার ৪২২টি উপজেলা জুড়ে তার উন্নয়ন কার্যক্রম সম্প্রসারিত করেছে এবং এর মাধ্যমে ১ কোটি ৫৭ লক্ষের বেশি দরিদ্র ও ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ মানুষের কাছে সেবা পৌঁছে দিচ্ছে। দায়িত্ব-কর্তব্য সমুহঃ নির্দেশানুসারে প্রজেক্টের গাড়ি চালিয়ে কর্মী, অংশীদার এবং অতিথিদের পরিবহন করা।  সব সময় যাত্রী এবং গাড়ির নিরাপত্তা নিশ্চিত করা।  নির্ধারিত গাড়ির পরিচ্ছন্নতা ও নিয়মিত রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ সুনিশ্চিত করা।  গাড়ির মাইলফলক (মাইলেজ), জ্বালানির ব্যবহার, সার্ভিসিং এবং যেকোনো দুর্ঘটনার বিস্তারিত তথ্যসহ লগবুক সংরক্ষণ করা।  ট্রাফিক আইন এবং প্রতিষ্ঠানের নিয়মকানুন কঠোরভাবে মেনে চলা।  মালামাল, সামগ্রী এবং কাগজপত্র পরিবহনের মাধ্যমে লজিস্টিকস ও প্রজেক্টের কার্যক্রমে সহায়তা করা।  প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী মালামাল তোলা ও নামানোর কাজে সাহায্য করা।  যেকোনো যান্ত্রিক ত্রুটি বা দুর্ঘটনা অবিলম্বে সুপারভাইজারকে রিপোর্ট করা।  গাড়ির প্রয়োজনীয় সকল কাগজপত্র (লাইসেন্স, রেজিস্ট্রেশন, ইন্স্যুরেন্স ইত্যাদি) হালনাগাদ রয়েছে তা নিশ্চিত করা।  ড্রাইভিংয়ের কাজ না থাকলে অন্যান্য প্রশাসনিক কাজে সাহায্য করা।

job_description: Job Context: Friends in Village Development Bangladesh (FIVDB) is going to implement a multi-sectoral project, “Ensuring continued access to immediate lifesaving integrated primary health, WASH and protection services for the Rohingya refugees in Camps 26 and 27, Nhila Union, Teknaf”, delivered as a partner of a consortium led by Tdh Bangladesh. The project will address critical GBV, health, and hygiene-related issues through various prevention and response interventions – community mobilization focusing on protection, Health/Nutrition through an outreach team, GBV Emergency Case Management, structured MHPSS, Youth-led community protection initiatives, and structured Girl Shine and EMB sessions. The Community Volunteer will support the facilitation of structured GBV prevention sessions and MHPSS sessions for Rohingya children and adults. S/he will assist the GBV Officer and GBV Case Worker in organizing and conducting sessions, engaging participants, promoting psychosocial wellbeing and positive gender norms, and referring concerns safely through the established referral pathway. The volunteer does not provide individual counselling or case management; these services are provided only by the trained project staff. Key Area 1: Session Support & Facilitation Support the GBV Officer in conducting structured GBV prevention sessions for Rohingya children and adults using approved modules and guidelines. Assist in facilitating group psychosocial support sessions, life-skills activities, and stress-management activities for women, girls, boys, men, and community members. Help to prepare session venues, materials, and participant lists, and ensure the session space is safe, private, and welcoming. Use age-, gender-, and disability-appropriate approaches, and culturally appropriate and conflict-sensitive language during sessions. Support translation and interpretation between Bangla, Chittagonian, and Rohingya where needed, ensuring the meaning of messages is not changed. Promote positive gender norms, positive coping strategies, resilience, and community-based support mechanisms. Key Area 2: Community Engagement & Awareness Mobilize participants for sessions in coordination with community leaders, CiCs, Mahjis, women leaders, and outreach workers. Engage respectfully with community leaders, women’s groups, parents, and adolescents to reduce stigma around GBV and mental health. Support early identification of signs of distress and risk among session participants and community members. Share project information and service availability with the community in a clear and respectful way. Key Area 3: Safe Referral & Confidentiality Do not conduct counselling, interviews, or investigation of GBV or child protection incidents; respond with basic Psychological First Aid (PFA) principles only. Report any disclosure, distress, or safety concern immediately to the GBV Case Worker and GBV Officer, and do not share survivor information with anyone else. Support safe referral of individuals to GBV, MHPSS, health, child protection, and other services through the established referral pathway, with the informed consent of the individual. Maintain strict confidentiality and respect the dignity, safety, and choices of survivors and participants at all times. Key Area 4: Documentation & Reporting Maintain accurate attendance sheets and session records without collecting identifying information about survivors. Submit weekly activity updates to the GBV Case Worker and GBV Officer, highlighting participation, community feedback, challenges, and concerns. Share field observations and community feedback to support programme learning, following “do no harm” principles and informed consent. Key Area 5: Capacity Development Attend orientation, training, and refresher sessions on GBV guiding principles, PFA, safeguarding, PSEA, child safeguarding, and referral pathways. Receive on-the-job coaching and support from the GBV Officer. Practice self-care and inform the supervisor if emotional support is needed. Key Area 6: Safeguarding, Ethics & Accountability Uphold FIVDB’s safeguarding, PSEA, child safeguarding, and Code of Conduct policies at all times. Ensure session spaces are safe for children and adults, and never be alone with a child or participant in a private setting. Immediately report safeguarding concerns, ethical dilemmas, or risks in line with organizational procedures. Promote accountability, respect, and cultural sensitivity in all interactions with participants, communities, and colleagues. Any other tasks assigned by the Supervisor.

job_description: প্রকল্পের গবাদিপশুর সঠিক লালন-পালন, খাদ্য ব্যবস্থাপনা, স্বাস্থ্য ও পরিচর্যা নিশ্চিত করা এবং খামারের দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রম সুষ্ঠুভাবে পরিচালনা ও তদারকি করার জন্য একজন দায়িত্বশীল, পরিশ্রমী ও অভিজ্ঞ জনবল নিয়োগ দেওয়া হবে। প্রধান দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য  গবাদিপশুর দৈনন্দিন পরিচর্যা, লালন-পালন ও সার্বিক দেখাশোনা নিশ্চিত করা।  পশুর খাবার, বিশুদ্ধ পানি ও পুষ্টিকর খাদ্য সরবরাহের ব্যবস্থা তদারকি করা।  পশুর স্বাস্থ্য পর্যবেক্ষণ, অসুস্থতা শনাক্তকরণ এবং প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী ভেটেরিনারি ডাক্তারের পরামর্শে চিকিৎসার ব্যবস্থা করা।  পশুর টিকাদান, কৃমিনাশক প্রয়োগ ও নিয়মিত স্বাস্থ্য পরীক্ষার রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ করা।  পশুর বাসস্থান, গোয়ালঘর, খাদ্য সংরক্ষণ স্থান ও আশপাশের পরিবেশ পরিষ্কার-পরিচ্ছন্ন রাখা নিশ্চিত করা।  পশুর জন্ম, মৃত্যু, ক্রয়-বিক্রয়, ওজন, উৎপাদন ও অন্যান্য প্রয়োজনীয় তথ্য রেজিস্টারে সংরক্ষণ করা।  পশুখাদ্য, ওষুধ ও অন্যান্য উপকরণের ব্যবহার এবং মজুতের হিসাব রাখা।  ফার্মের কর্মচারী ও শ্রমিকদের কাজ বণ্টন, উপস্থিতি এবং কার্যক্রম তদারকি করা।  পশুর সংখ্যা, স্বাস্থ্য, খাদ্য ব্যবহার, উৎপাদন ও দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রমের প্রতিবেদন কর্তৃপক্ষের কাছে উপস্থাপন করা।  পশুর নিরাপত্তা, রোগ প্রতিরোধ, বায়োসিকিউরিটি এবং খামারের শৃঙ্খলা বজায় রাখা।  পশুপালনের খরচ নিয়ন্ত্রণ এবং অপচয় কমানোর উদ্যোগ গ্রহণ করা।  কর্তৃপক্ষের নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী প্রকল্পের অন্যান্য সংশ্লিষ্ট দায়িত্ব পালন করা।

রোগীর সার্বিক পরিচর্যা নিশ্চিত করবেন। কর্মস্থলঃ  প্লানেট হাসপাতাল , মাদারীপুর। দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্যঃ অপারেশন থিয়েটারের দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রম সুষ্ঠুভাবে পরিচালনা ও তদারকি করা। সার্জারি শুরুর পূর্বে ওটি সম্পূর্ণ প্রস্তুত (Ready for Surgery) আছে কিনা তা নিশ্চিত করা। ওটি নার্স, টেকনোলজিস্ট ও অন্যান্য সহায়ক কর্মীদের ডিউটি রোস্টার প্রস্তুত ও তদারকি করা। সার্জিক্যাল যন্ত্রপাতি, মেশিন ও মেডিকেল ইকুইপমেন্টের কার্যকারিতা নিয়মিত পরীক্ষা ও রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ নিশ্চিত করা। অপারেশনের জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় ওষুধ, কনজ্যুমেবলস ও সার্জিক্যাল সামগ্রীর পর্যাপ্ত মজুদ নিশ্চিত করা। সংক্রমণ প্রতিরোধ (Infection Prevention & Control) নীতিমালা, জীবাণুমুক্তকরণ (Sterilization) এবং অ্যাসেপটিক টেকনিক যথাযথভাবে অনুসরণ হচ্ছে কিনা তা নিশ্চিত করা। রোগীর নিরাপত্তা নিশ্চিত করতে WHO Surgical Safety Checklist যথাযথভাবে অনুসরণ করা। সার্জন, অ্যানেসথেসিওলজিস্ট, নার্সিং টিম ও অন্যান্য সংশ্লিষ্ট বিভাগের সঙ্গে কার্যকর সমন্বয় বজায় রাখা। অপারেশন থিয়েটারের পরিচ্ছন্নতা, স্বাস্থ্যবিধি ও বায়োসেফটি মানদণ্ড বজায় রাখা। জরুরি অপারেশনের জন্য ওটি সর্বদা প্রস্তুত রাখা এবং প্রয়োজনীয় জনবল ও সরঞ্জামের ব্যবস্থা করা। অপারেশন সংক্রান্ত সকল রেজিস্টার, লগবুক, রিপোর্ট ও ডকুমেন্টেশন যথাযথভাবে সংরক্ষণ ও হালনাগাদ করা। নতুন ওটি স্টাফদের ওরিয়েন্টেশন, প্রশিক্ষণ এবং দক্ষতা উন্নয়ন কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করা। যন্ত্রপাতির ত্রুটি বা দুর্ঘটনা ঘটলে দ্রুত সংশ্লিষ্ট বিভাগকে অবহিত করা এবং প্রয়োজনীয় ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করা। অপারেশন থিয়েটারে নিরাপত্তা বিধি, অগ্নি-নিরাপত্তা ও জরুরি প্রতিক্রিয়া (Emergency Response) ব্যবস্থা নিশ্চিত করা। বায়োমেডিক্যাল বর্জ্য (Biomedical Waste) সঠিকভাবে পৃথকীকরণ, সংরক্ষণ ও নিষ্পত্তি নিশ্চিত করা। ওটি-সংক্রান্ত বাজেট, স্টোর, ইনভেন্টরি ও সম্পদ ব্যবস্থাপনায় প্রশাসনকে সহায়তা করা। হাসপাতালের নীতিমালা, মান নিয়ন্ত্রণ (Quality Assurance) এবং অ্যাক্রেডিটেশন মানদণ্ড অনুসরণ নিশ্চিত করা। রোগীর গোপনীয়তা (Patient Confidentiality) ও নৈতিক মানদণ্ড কঠোরভাবে বজায় রাখা। ওটি-সংক্রান্ত অভিযোগ, সমস্যা বা অনাকাঙ্ক্ষিত ঘটনা (Incident) তদন্ত করে প্রয়োজনীয় সংশোধনমূলক ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করা। হাসপাতাল কর্তৃপক্ষের নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য প্রশাসনিক ও পেশাগত দায়িত্ব যথাযথভাবে পালন করা।

Key Responsibilities: Donor Assessment & Care: Conduct pre-donation medical screening of donors, including health history and physical examination. Training & Public Awareness: Train healthcare staff, nurses, and volunteers in donor screening, blood collection, and emergency management. Participate in awareness campaigns to promote voluntary blood donation and educate the public on blood safety. Research & Continuous Improvement: Contribute to research and advancements in transfusion medicine. Stay updated on medical best practices, emerging diseases, and innovations in blood banking.

job_description: Shushilan, a national reputed NGO has been implementing a project entitled “Meeting Targets and Maintaining Epidemic Control (EpiC) Project Bangladesh” with technical and financial support from FHI 360. Meeting Targets and Maintaining Epidemic Control (EpiC) project is a global project funded by the US Department of State and the US President’s Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief (PEPFAR), that provides strategic technical assistance and direct service delivery to strengthen Global Health Security (GHS), including outbreak response; improve maternal and child health (MCH), and promote health systems strengthening (HSS) including supply chain management.  EpiC is led by FHI 360 with it’s implementation partners including Shushilan working in seven districts of Bangladesh where Shushilan is working in Jashore and Satkhira district. Shushilan is inviting application from the qualified and interested candidates for the following position. The Technical Officer will provide facility-based technical support to strengthen the quality of maternal, newborn, child health and nutrition services, and to embed global health security practice within routine service delivery. The role is deliberately field-weighted. The position holder is the technical counterpart of the project in assigned District Hospitals and Upazila Health Complexes, supporting quality service provision within the facility. S/he will support facility readiness through optimization of existing resources and is expected to spend most of the working time within health facilities, observing standard clinical practice, providing technical support to providers through on-the-job coaching (OJC), facilitating the mentoring process, and verifying data to monitor service utilization. S/he will also ensure need-based project initiatives, recording and reporting. Key Responsibilities & Essential Duties 1. MNCS-N Service Delivery & Facility Readiness Routine support to MNCH-N service corners for facility readiness at assigned District Hospitals and Upazila Health Complexes so that they remain equipped and functional to deliver quality MNCH-N services through optimum utilization of existing resources. Support resource mobilization by leveraging non-health local government sector resources to address priority readiness gaps, in coordination with the Upazila Coordinator, District Manager, District Coordinator and government counterparts. Strengthening the referral system (From UHC to district level facility) 2. Mentorship Program & On-the-Job Coaching Provide targeted and structured on-the-job coaching (OJC) sessions on MNCH-N services including ANC/PNC, normal vaginal delivery, correct use of the partograph, essential newborn care, KMC/SCANU, low-cost CPAP use, IMCI-Nutrition, IPC, and dissemination of messages on selected infectious diseases. Support planning, implementing and monitoring of the structured clinical mentorship procedure with practical demonstrations and simulation practice across assigned facilities, following national standards and under the close supervision of the Technical Specialist. Observe and follow up session logs, conduct of sessions and recording of the mentorship procedure; identify individual and facility-level competency gaps and organize targeted refresher sessions. Suggest and support mid-level providers (MLPs) in the initial management of complications of pregnancy, such as postpartum hemorrhage and eclampsia, through OJC, and ensure timely referral with accurate documentation. 3. Quality Improvement Committee (QIC) & Work Improvement Team (WIT) Support the establishment and revitalization of facility-level Quality Improvement Committees (QIC), Work Improvement Teams (WIT) and IPC committees. Support strengthened implementation of MPDSR through establishing and revitalizing MPDSR committees at facility level. Facilitate regular WIT meetings, encouraging team members and frontline staff to participate in problem-solving processes as per quality improvement action plans, and ensure findings are shared during QIC meetings. 4. Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) Deliver on-the-job coaching sessions on Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) and healthcare waste handling and management to clinical and non-clinical support staff. Facilitate and provide technical support for continuous IPC readiness to maintain a clean and safe healthcare environment for patients and staff. 5. Global Health Security, RCCE and Outbreak Preparedness Integrate approved GHS, IPC, hygiene, early reporting and protective behaviour messages into routine MNCH-N service contacts. Strengthen the process of dissemination of approved risk communication and community engagement (RCCE) messages on priority zoonotic and selected infectious diseases during counselling and health education at various service points. Play a vital role during CHCP monthly meetings regarding dissemination and follow-up of approved RCCE messages, including IPC, hygiene and protective behaviors. Support facility teams during public health events and outbreak response by leveraging MNCH-N service delivery platforms to promote protective behaviors and sustain essential MNCH-N services. Contribute to strengthening early reporting of unusual health events at facility level, and support the nearby Point of Entry (PoE) on cross-border disease prevention initiatives by improving compliance with screening standards, under the guidance of the Technical Specialist, District Manager and District Coordinator. 6. Stakeholder Coordination & Health Systems Strengthening Maintain regular liaison and communication with stakeholders and government counterparts such as the Public Health Nurse, Health Education Officer and Health Inspector, under the supervision of the Technical Specialist, District Manager and District Coordinator. Facilitate organizing and attending capacity-building initiatives, meetings and workshops at Upazila and district level. 7. Data Quality, Monitoring & Reporting Monitor and support optimization of MNCH-N service utilization, and ensure project-related documentation and reporting. Prepare monthly, quarterly and event-based technical reports summarizing key accomplishments, mentorship outcomes, QI metrics and field findings.   8. Others Respect, maintain and monitor code of conduct practice; All kind of positive motivation to support and response in emergency; In addition to that any other duties and responsibilities may assigned by the authority / organization which need to be carried out.

job_description: Job Context Eco-Social Development Organization (ESDO) started its journey in 1988 with a noble vision to stand in solidarity with the poor and marginalized. Near about three decades of relentless efforts to make this happen, ESDO has embraced new grounds and opened up new horizons to help the disadvantaged and vulnerable people to bring meaningful and lasting changes in their lives. ESDO is one of the most dynamic organizations expanding its development interventions across 422 upazilas under 56 districts of Bangladesh covering over 10 million poor and vulnerable people. The Finance Associate is the operational backbone of the project`s finance function and first point of financial verification. The position is responsible for the day-to-day accounting, transaction processing, budget tracking, cash and bank management, financial documentation, and preparation of the financial reports and instruments that keep the project`s cash flow compliant with UNICEF`s Harmonized Approach to Cash Transfers (HACT) and audit-ready at all times. The position ensures that every financial transaction is recorded accurately, coded correctly against the approved budget, supported by complete documentation, and processed within the timelines that Direct Cash Transfer (DCT) cycles demand. The Finance Associate will work under the direct supervision of the Admin and Finance Manager and coordinate closely with the Procurement Associate, HR and Admin Associate, and programme colleagues to keep the project`s financial engine running smoothly. Financial Management, Accounting, and Transaction Processing Maintain project accounts, books of records, ledgers, and supporting documents in line with ESDO`s accounting policies, IPSAS standards, HACT policies and donor’s other requirements. Prepare payment vouchers, journal vouchers, cash vouchers, and bank vouchers with correct budget coding and complete supporting documentation. Verify bills, invoices, and supporting documents for accuracy, completeness, and compliance before payment processing. Record all financial transactions in the accounting system on time and with accurate output and activity-line coding. Maintain cash books, bank books, and all financial registers as per policy. 2. Support in preparing inputs for DCT requests so that requests can be cleared and submitted to UNICEF at least fifteen days before the start of each quarter. Support in preparing liquidation documentation, FACE forms, and expenditure statements so that quarterly liquidation is completed and submitted within fifteen days of quarter end, in strict compliance with HACT timelines. Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, budget variance analyses, and inputs to donor financial reports. Support budget forecasting and cash flow planning under the direction of the Admin and Finance Manager. 3. Cash and Bank Management Monitor project cash balances and banking transactions on a daily basis and prepare bank reconciliation statements on a regular basis. Maintain accurate records of cash advances, adjustments, settlements, and outstanding balances. Ensure secure handling of cheques, cash, and financial instruments in accordance with internal control procedures. Support cash flow monitoring, fund management, disbursement to prevent delays in payments to volunteers, vendors, and landowners. 4. Compliance, Statutory Obligations, and Documentation Ensure compliance with UNICEF financial guidelines, PCA requirements, HACT rules, and ESDO`s financial policies in every transaction process. Ensure statutory deductions (VAT, tax, and other levies) are calculated, withheld, and deposited to the relevant authorities on time, and that returns are filed in accordance with Government of Bangladesh requirements. Maintain complete, well-indexed, and secure financial documentation and filing systems (physical and electronic) for audit, spot check and donor review. Support the Admin and Finance Manager in responding to audit observations and implementing recommendations. 5. Audit Support, Internal Controls, and Risk Awareness Support internal audits, UNICEF financial spot checks, programmatic spot checks, HACT assurance activities, and any external or donor audits by providing accurate documentation, reconciliations, and explanations. Follow internal control procedures diligently, including segregation of duties, authorization thresholds, and dual-signature requirements. Stay alert to fraud risk indicators and unusual transactions, and escalate any concerns immediately to the Admin and Finance Manager. Contribute to the project`s risk register by flagging emerging financial or operational risks observed in day-to-day work. 6. Cross-Functional Financial Support Coordinate with the Procurement Associate, the other Finance Associate on payment processing, vendor documentation, and reconciliation of procurement transactions. Coordinate with the HR and Admin Associate on payroll processing, staff advances, volunteer incentive disbursements, and benefits payments. Assist in administrative and operational financial matters as required. 7. Safeguarding, Accountability, and Ethical Practice Uphold the highest standards of Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA), Child Safeguarding (CSG), Accountability to Affected Populations (AAP), and anti-fraud behavior in every financial transaction processed. Maintain strict confidentiality of financial, personnel, and community feedback information. Ensure that financial dealings with vendors, service providers, volunteers, and community members reflect integrity, transparency, and dignity. 8. job_description: CIPLC is looking for a qualified and hands-on  Executive – Health & Safety  to support HSE implementation across assigned EPC project sites. The role will be responsible for implementing the project HSE plan, conducting hazard identification and risk assessments, managing permit-to-work requirements, conducting safety inspections and toolbox talks, delivering HSE inductions and training, monitoring subcontractor compliance, investigating incidents and near-misses, and maintaining HSE records and reports. The position will also support emergency response, first aid, fire safety and other site safety requirements in coordination with project teams and relevant stakeholders. HSE Plan & Risk Management: Implement the project HSE plan, safety procedures and site rules at assigned project sites. Conduct hazard identification, risk assessments and Job Safety Analyses (JSA) for site activities. Ensure identified risk controls are implemented and maintained. Support the Assistant Manager – QA & Planning in monitoring overall site HSE compliance. Permit-to-work & Site Safety: Manage the Permit-to-Work system for work at height, hot work, lifting, excavation and electrical works including LOTO. Conduct daily safety inspections and toolbox talks. Ensure proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Monitor site activities and stop unsafe work when required. Monitor housekeeping, waste management, dust and noise control at site. Training & Emergency Preparedness: Deliver HSE induction for new workers, subcontractors and visitors. Organize safety training programs and emergency drills. Ensure first aid, fire safety and emergency response arrangements are available at site. Promote safety awareness among workers and project teams. Equipment & Worksite Inspection: Inspect lifting equipment, scaffolding, ladders, tools and fire extinguishers. Inspect temporary electrical installations and monitor electrical safety requirements. Monitor compliance with work-at-height, lifting and other high-risk activity requirements. Incident Investigation & Corrective Actions: Investigate incidents and near-misses and identify root causes. Follow up on corrective and preventive actions. Report HSE violations and monitor resolution. Maintain appropriate incident and corrective-action records. HSE Reporting & Documentation: Maintain HSE registers, man-hour and incident statistics. Maintain inspection reports and training records. Prepare weekly and monthly HSE reports for the Assistant Manager – QA & Planning and the client. Maintain accurate HSE documentation and statistics.

job_description: About the Organization Shakti Foundation for Disadvantaged Women (Shakti Foundation) is a national development organization and microfinance institution working across Bangladesh since 1992. The organization is committed to the socio-economic empowerment of disadvantaged women through social and financial inclusion. Beginning with a pilot urban microfinance program for slum-dwelling women in Dhaka, Shakti Foundation has strategically expanded its service network into rural areas and now serves more than 6 lac members through a nationwide network of 648 branches across 57 districts. Alongside microfinance, its programming spans health, climate change, financial inclusion and women’s empowerment, supported by an extensive field presence and community-based delivery platforms. Shakti is registered with the NGO Affairs Bureau of Bangladesh under the Foreign Donations (Voluntary Activities) Regulation Rules and with the Registrar of Joint Stock Companies and Firms under the Societies Registration Act 1860. It is also licensed by the Microcredit Regulatory Authority (MRA) to operate its microfinance program. Bangladesh faces escalating climate risks, including extreme heat, flooding, cyclones, salinity intrusion, water stress, ecosystem degradation and climate-sensitive health threats. These risks affect low-income women and other vulnerable populations disproportionately and can disrupt Shakti Foundation’s operations, assets, workforce, clients and service delivery. At the same time, Shakti Foundation’s reach creates opportunities to integrate climate resilience, environmental responsibility and low-carbon practices across programs and institutional systems. Under the Inclusive Climate Finance for Vulnerable Communities in Asia Pacific (ICCAP) program, Shakti Foundation intends to engage a qualified consultant or consulting firm to develop an organization-wide Climate Strategy and a practical Monitoring & Reporting Framework. The assignment will translate climate commitments into prioritized, costed and measurable actions, with clear governance, indicators, data tools, accountability and reporting arrangements. Project Context The Inclusive Climate Finance for Vulnerable Communities in the Asia Pacific (ICCAP) is a five-year regional project implemented by a consortium of three partners: Appui au Développement Autonome (ADA), the Asia Pacific Rural and Agricultural Credit Association (APRACA), and the Stockholm Environment Institute (SEI). The project aims to improve and scale up access to both public and private climate finance flows through Financial Service Providers (FSPs) to vulnerable communities across the Asia-Pacific region, including Bangladesh, Bhutan, Cambodia, Fiji, Lao PDR, and Nepal. The project is financed by the International Climate Initiative (IKI) as part of the German Government’s international climate finance commitment. In Bangladesh, ADA is providing technical assistance to partner FSPs, including Shakti Foundation, to strengthen their capacity to integrate climate considerations into financial products, institutional strategies, operations, and monitoring systems. Under Work Package 2, Activity 1.2 of the ICCAP Technical Assistance Grant, Shakti Foundation will develop and implement a Board-approved Integrated Climate Strategy covering climate finance and green internal operations; a Shakti climate finance taxonomy aligned with the Bangladesh Green Taxonomy; and a monitoring and reporting system that is embedded in Shakti`s core ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system and supported by a practical tracking tool for internal operations, with staff trained to use it. Objective The purpose of the consultancy is to provide Shakti Foundation with an evidence-based and implementable climate strategy, together with a monitoring and reporting system that enables the organization to plan, track, learn from and communicate its climate-related performance and results. Specifically, the consultancy will: Define a climate vision, strategic objectives and a 5-year roadmap aligned with Shakti’s institutional mission and its focus on women (Action 1.2.1). Develop an institutional climate finance taxonomy aligned with the Bangladesh Green Taxonomy and contextualized to Shakti Foundation’s target clients, priority sectors, financial products, and operational model (Action 1.2.2). Develop an internal Green Operations Strategy to strengthen Shakti Foundation’s environmental performance, with a focus on paper reduction, energy efficiency, waste management, and other relevant operational measures (Action 1.2.3). Facilitate stakeholder workshops, board presentation and formal approval of an Integrated Climate Strategy (Action 1.2.4). Establish a Climate Monitoring and Reporting Framework by defining standardized indicators for the climate portfolio covering climate finance and green internal operations, along with standardized reporting templates and practical data requirements (Action 1.2.5). Specify the data requirements for, and quality-assure, the integration of taxonomy and climate finance indicators into Shakti’s core ERP system by Shakti’s IT team (Action 1.2.6). Establish an Excel-based tracking system for internal green operations indicators to support regular data collection, monitoring, analysis, and reporting of Shakti Foundation’s environmental performance (Action 1.2.7). Strengthen institutional capacity by building the knowledge and skills of relevant Shakti Foundation staff to implement the Climate Strategy and M&R Framework, collect and manage climate-related data, track indicators and effectively use reporting tools and dashboards (Action 1.2.8). Expected Outputs Inception Report, including the detailed work plan and allocation of professional days. Board-approved Integrated Climate Strategy for Shakti, incorporating climate finance vision, objectives and strategic roadmap. Shakti Climate Finance Taxonomy aligned with the Bangladesh Green Taxonomy, with loan categorization codes, ERP tags, application guidance, product mapping, pilot results and an indicative portfolio estimate. Internal Green Operations Strategy with baseline assessment, targets, costed measures and green office guidelines. Stakeholder Consultation Reports and Board Presentation. Climate Monitoring and Reporting Framework, including indicator reference sheets and three core reporting templates. ERP Data Requirements Specification, test scenarios and ERP Integration Review Note. Tested Excel Internal Operations Tracking Tool and User Guide. SOP Manual, Training Materials and Training-of-Trainers Completion Report with cascade plan. Final Assignment Report and Handover Package. Duration and Working Modality Duration:  6 months from contract signing Work Approach: Evidence-Based Assessment: Conduct comprehensive desk reviews, data-gap assessments, and climate risk/vulnerability analyses that merge credible secondary data with institutional and community-level experiences. Participatory Engagement & Co-Design: Facilitate key-informant interviews, field visits, and focused co-design sessions across all levels—from frontline staff and community stakeholders to program/support functions—to ensure deep institutional ownership of the strategy and monitoring frameworks. Iterative Development & Testing: Utilize a feedback-driven process to draft, validate, and practically pilot-test strategies, monitoring indicators, and tools before finalization. Capacity Building: Deliver targeted training and capacity-building initiatives to ensure the organization can seamlessly implement and sustain the new frameworks. Ethical & Inclusive Integration: Mainstream gender equality, social inclusion, safeguarding, "do-no-harm" principles, data protection, and ethical participation throughout all phases of the assignment. Alignment by design: outputs are developed against international climate finance conventions from the outset, so that they remain usable as Shakti`s funding base widens, without substantial rework. Field Requirements: Field engagement at selected branches is required for the operations baseline, pilot testing and staff training. Coordination: Close coordination with Shakti Foundation Technical Working Group and ICCAP focal persons. A Technical Working Group (TWG) will be formed, comprising representatives from Shakti Foundation Climate Change Program, Microfinance Operations, Finance and Accounts, IT, Administration, Procurement, Human Resources and relevant operational units. Shakti will provide access to relevant institutional data, systems, staff and branch locations, subject to its confidentiality and data protection requirements. The Consultant/Firm is responsible for its own logistics, equipment, travel and workspace arrangements unless otherwise agreed.

job_description: Senior Full-Stack Developer (TypeScript / Supabase) — Quality & Reliability Full-time · Remote (Bangladesh-based) · $2,000 USD/month  Commitment:  This is a full 40-hour-per-week role. It is your primary job, not a side project alongside other clients or contracts. English:  Excellent spoken and written English is required. You'll be on live video calls with the founder regularly and working directly with him — there is no manager translating between you. Hours:  You set your own schedule, but we need at least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern time — roughly 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM Bangladesh time. About The Role We're building and operating two growing SaaS products using a highly AI-assisted development model. We move quickly, ship frequently, and use tools like Claude Code to accelerate development. What we need now is someone who can make sure  everything continues to work as the products grow. This is not a traditional "sit down and code tickets all day" engineering role. You'll be the person responsible for having eyes on the technical health of the business — making sure new features don't break existing ones, errors get caught and fixed, systems work together properly, and our products remain stable as we continue to build rapidly with AI. You'll work closely with the founder/product team and use AI coding tools as part of your everyday workflow. Our Stack We're not going to make you guess. Here's what's actually running: Frontend React + TypeScript + Vite for the customer-facing product Lightweight vanilla JS/HTML single-page apps for our internal analytics dashboards (fast, no framework tax) Deployed on Vercel with git-connected auto-deploys, preview builds, custom domains Backend & data Supabase across several projects: Postgres, SQL migrations, RPC/SQL functions, Row Level Security, Supabase Auth Edge Functions written in TypeScript/Deno — this is where most of our business logic lives Scheduled work via pg_cron; server-side rollups for anything the client shouldn't be paging through Node.js services where we need something outside the edge runtime Integrations — honestly, this is the job GoHighLevel (CRM, leads, invoices, payments) and Follow Up Boss Google Analytics 4, Google OAuth / sign-in, Google Business Profile Meta / Facebook Marketing API (campaigns, creatives, catalogs) Cloudinary (media pipeline), Resend (transactional email), Airtable, Plaid, Shopify, WordPress REST API, Semrush, Zapier Lots of webhooks, OAuth token handling, and third-party rate limits Automation & CI GitHub Actions pipelines (Node + Python) that build and deploy content automatically Scheduled Claude agents that run unattended against our repos — they clone, do real work, and push Reusable agent "skills" committed into the repo so humans and AI follow the same playbook Testing & monitoring (today) A committed Playwright/Node smoke suite that walks a dashboard end to end with external services stubbed GA4 and Microsoft Clarity on the front end Health/status rows written by each automated routine so we can see when one silently stopped Expanding our error tracking and alerting (Sentry or similar) is an early project you'd lead Mobile iOS App Store distribution and push notifications for the agent-facing product; PWA install today, native wrapper (Capacitor) on the roadmap AI tooling Claude Code daily, MCP servers wired into our tools, AI-generated pull requests as a normal part of the workflow What You'll Own Testing & Quality Make sure new features are properly tested before release Build and maintain automated tests for critical user workflows — signup/auth, lead capture, billing and revenue reporting Test that changes in one part of the application don't break another Create regression tests when bugs are discovered Regularly test the products from the perspective of a real user Establish a reliable pre-release testing process (today it's a smoke suite and a careful human; it should be CI) System Monitoring & Error Detection Monitor application errors, failed processes, broken integrations and unexpected behavior Investigate issues before they become major problems Set up systems that alert us when something breaks Identify patterns in recurring errors Make sure important failures are visible rather than silently occurring in the background Cross-System Reliability Our SaaS products involve multiple interconnected systems, databases, APIs, automations and third-party services. You will make sure those pieces continue to work together. A real chain from our stack: Website form → Supabase Edge Function → CRM contact created → sync table → dashboard leads board → automated text/email → GA4 conversion event → revenue reporting When that breaks, it usually breaks quietly — the board just stops filling up. If something breaks anywhere along that chain, you should be able to identify where it happened, why it happened, and how to prevent it from happening again. AI-Assisted Development Oversight Work alongside Claude Code and other AI development tools Review AI-generated code before or after it reaches production Catch architectural problems and unintended side effects from AI-generated changes Establish guardrails for what AI can safely modify — including our scheduled agents that push code and write to production data unattended Use AI aggressively for implementation while maintaining human oversight of quality and architecture Help improve our development process so we can ship faster without becoming fragile Bug Fixing & Technical Maintenance Diagnose and fix production bugs Clean up technical debt before it becomes a larger problem Refactor areas of the application that have become unnecessarily complex Improve performance and reliability Keep dependencies, environments and infrastructure healthy — including keeping deployed edge functions and the code in the repo from drifting apart Document important technical decisions and system behavior Architecture & Long-Term Health You don't need to rebuild everything. You do need to recognize when something we've built is going in the wrong direction. You'll periodically assess: Is this architecture still making sense? Are we creating unnecessary complexity? Are there duplicated systems or logic? Are our database structures healthy? Are our APIs and integrations reliable? Are we creating technical debt faster than we're paying it down? What needs to be fixed now versus what can wait? Early Projects So you know what you'd be working on in your first few months — this is a real, working, revenue-producing stack: Expand error tracking and alerting so failures surface on their own Ongoing security review across our projects — access controls, permissions and credential management Automated regression coverage on our most important user paths Tighter deployment discipline so what's running always matches what's in the repo Continued performance work — moving heavy queries server-side instead of having clients page through large result sets Guardrails on what our AI agents are allowed to modify without a human in the loop What Success Looks Like Six months from now, the founder should be able to say: "I can move fast without being afraid that something is quietly breaking behind me." We should have: Reliable automated testing Clear monitoring and error reporting Critical workflows continuously tested Fewer production surprises Fast identification and resolution of bugs Confidence that new features aren't breaking existing functionality A clean process for using AI to build and modify the product Someone who understands the entire technical ecosystem and knows where the risks are Who We're Looking For You are probably a great fit if you are: A strong senior software engineer or technical lead Available full-time, 40 hours per week, with this as your only job An excellent English speaker — comfortable on live video calls, explaining technical decisions clearly and pushing back when you disagree Comfortable working across the full stack — TypeScript on both ends, SQL when it matters Extremely good at debugging, especially across service boundaries Naturally skeptical of "it seems to work" Strong with testing and quality assurance Comfortable understanding unfamiliar codebases quickly Experienced with APIs, databases, integrations and third-party services — particularly webhook-driven, OAuth-authenticated, rate-limited ones Comfortable working with AI coding tools such as Claude Code Able to review AI-generated code and recognize when something is fundamentally wrong More interested in making systems  reliable and scalable  than simply writing more code Comfortable operating independently and telling us what needs attention Bonus Points Hands-on experience with: Supabase / Postgres (RLS, migrations, edge functions) — or a strong Postgres scale (agents, MCP, prompt/skill design) This Is Not This isn't a role where we expect you to personally write every feature. We want to use AI to dramatically increase development velocity. Your job is to make sure that velocity doesn't turn into chaos. You'll help us build a development environment where AI can move incredibly fast while a highly capable human is continuously watching the system, testing the important things, and keeping the architecture healthy. Monitor continuously. Fix problems quickly. Keep the system healthy. পরিপাটি উপস্থিতি এবং পেশাদার আচরণ বজায় রাখা আবশ্যক। বৈদ্যুতিকরক্ষণাবেক্ষণ: বৈদ্যুতিক সরঞ্জাম স্থাপন , রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ, ত্রুটি নির্ণয় ও মেরামতের কাজ করা। বৈদ্যুতিক সরঞ্জাম, ওয়্যারিং, ডিস্ট্রিবিউশন বোর্ড, কন্ট্রোল প্যানেল এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট সিস্টেমগুলোর তদারকি ও রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ করা। ক্যাবল বসানো, ক্যাবল রুট নির্ধারণ, টার্মিনেশন এবং ইনস্টলেশনের কাজ তদারকি ও সম্পাদন করা। শর্ট সার্কিট হয়ে ঘরের লাইট-ফ্যান সম্পূর্ণ বন্ধ হয়ে গেলে তা ঠিক করা, পুড়ে যাওয়া ট্রান্সফরমার বা মোটর দ্রুত বদলে ফেলা। বিদ্যুৎ ও বিদ্যুৎ-ব্যবস্থা সংক্রান্ত ত্রুটি বা সমস্যা সমাধান করা এবং প্রয়োজনীয় সংশোধনমূলক ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করা। নিয়মিত মেইন সুইচ বা সার্কিট ব্রেকার চেক করা, লুজ কানেকশন টাইট দেওয়া। বৈদ্যুতিক সরঞ্জাম স্থাপন, পরীক্ষা , চালু করা এবং রক্ষণাবেক্ষণের কাজে সহায়তা করা। যে কোনও শীতাতপ নিয়ন্ত্রণ সিস্টেম স্থাপন, সার্ভিসিং, পরিচালনা ও রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ করা। উন্নত মানের ফিনিশিং বা কাজের মান বজায় রেখে ওয়্যারিং, লাইটিং এবং ক্যাবলিংয়ের মতো বৈদ্যুতিক কাজ করা। ডিজেল জেনারেটর, শীতাতপ নিয়ন্ত্রণ, ইলেকট্রিক গিজার, পানির পাম্প, মোটর এবং সোলার সিস্টেম পরিচালনা ও রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ করা। স্যানিটারি রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ: পানি সরবরাহ লাইন, ড্রেনেজ, বাথরুম ফিটিংস, পানির ট্যাংক, পাম্প ইত্যাদির রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ। পানি লিক, ব্লকেজ ও প্রেসার সমস্যা দ্রুত সমাধান করা। টয়লেট, সিন্ক, বেসিন, শাওয়ার, বাথটাব এবং কলসহ সব স্যানিটারি সামগ্রী সঠিকভাবে বসানো। পানির উচ্চ চাপ, গ্যাস এবং ড্রেনেজ লাইনে কোনো লিক, ব্লকেজ বা দুর্বলতা আছে কিনা তা পরীক্ষা ও শনাক্ত করা।। নষ্ট হয়ে যাওয়া ভালভ, ফেটে যাওয়া পাইপ এবং ত্রুটিপূর্ণ স্যানিটারি ইউনিট মেরামত বা পরিবর্তন করা। অফিসের সেন্ট্রাল ক্যাফেটেরিয়া, ডিশওয়াশার, কফি মেশিন লাইন, ওয়াটার পিউরিফায়ার এবং ওয়াটার কুলার বা ডিসপেনসারের লাইন সংযোগ ও রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ। অফিসের ওয়াশরুমের অটো-সেন্সর কল, ফ্লাশ ভালভ এবং পানির পাম্পের লাইনে কোনো লিক বা ব্লকেজ থাকলে তা দ্রুত সমাধান করা। লিফটও জেনারেটর রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ: লিফটের রুটিন সার্ভিসিং করা এবং কোনো পার্টস নষ্ট হলে তা দ্রুত পরিবর্তন করা। নিয়মিত জেনারেটর সার্ভিসিং এবং রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ করা। লিফট বা জেনারেটরে কোনো আকস্মিক যান্ত্রিক বা বৈদ্যুতিক ত্রুটি দেখা দিলে তা দ্রুত মেরামত করা। লোডশেডিংয়ের সাথে সাথে যেন অটোমেটিক জেনারেটর (ATS) চালু হয় তা নিশ্চিত করা এবং জেনারেটরের ফুয়েল ও ব্যাটারি ভোল্টেজ চেক করা। জেনারেটরের মোবিল বা ফিল্টার সময়মতো পরিবর্তন করা। প্রতিরোধমূলকও বিভ্রাট-জনিত রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ: ব্রেকডাউন সমস্যা দ্রুত সমাধান করে ডাউনটাইম কমানো। আকস্মিক দুর্ঘটনা বা বিকল হওয়া রোধ করা এবং যন্ত্রপাতির আয়ু বাড়ানো। রক্ষণাবেক্ষণের রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ করা এবং বৈদ্যুতিক সমস্যা বা ত্রুটি সম্পর্কে প্রতিবেদন প্রদান করা। যে কোনও বৈদ্যুতিক যন্ত্র সংক্রান্ত রেকর্ড এবং রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ প্রতিবেদন সংরক্ষণ করা।

Key Responsibilities Fabric R&D & Innovation Drive research and development of novel knit fabric structures, yarn blends (e.g., sustainable fibers, performance yarns, functional finishes), and eco-friendly dyeing/finishing techniques. Cross-Functional Integration Collaborate with Garment Merchandising and Production teams to address fabric-to-garment conversion challenges (e.g., spirality, sewing needle damage, wash effects). Advise pattern makers and sample room teams on fabric behavior, stretch factors, and garment wash allowances. Support costing teams by providing accurate technical consumption and fabric yield parameters. Leadership & Sustainability Lead and mentor a team of Fabric Technologists, R&D Executives, and Quality Controllers. Conduct procurement of goods and services from enlisted/approved vendors and through open competitive sourcing in accordance with the organization’s Procurement Policies, Procedures, and Delegation of Authority. Source and collect quotations, bids, and price proposals from approved vendors and open competitive markets, ensuring fairness, transparency, and competitiveness throughout the procurement process. Evaluate and compare quotations based on price, quality, specifications, delivery schedule, payment terms, vendor capability, and other relevant criteria. Prepare, issue, and maintain Purchase Orders (POs) in accordance with approved procurement decisions and ensure copies are shared with suppliers and relevant/requesting departments. Verify suppliers’ invoices/bills against approved quotations, bid evaluations, purchase orders, delivery documents, and agreed terms to ensure accuracy before submitting them to the Finance Department for payment processing. Maintain and regularly update the invoice and procurement database, including procurement records, supplier information, purchase values, and transaction status, and prepare relevant reports and data analysis as required. Coordinate with relevant departments and suppliers to inspect and verify delivered goods/services, ensuring that quantities, quality, specifications, and other requirements are consistent with the approved purchase order. Identify and report any shortages, damages, discrepancies, quality issues, or non-compliance in delivered goods/services and coordinate with suppliers and relevant departments for appropriate resolution. Maintain an up-to-date understanding of procurement policies, applicable legislation, donor requirements, ethical procurement standards, and industry best practices, and support continuous improvement of procurement processes. Support the development and maintenance of an effective supplier/vendor network, including vendor communication, performance monitoring, market research, and identification of reliable and competitive sources. Maintain professional relationships with suppliers, service providers, internal departments, and other stakeholders to ensure efficient procurement operations and support the organization’s objectives. Conduct market research and price analysis to identify competitive pricing, alternative suppliers, new products/services, and opportunities for cost optimization. Ensure procurement activities are conducted with integrity, transparency, accountability, confidentiality, and value-for-money principles. Provide procurement-related information, documentation, and reports to management, auditors, donors, and other authorized stakeholders when required. Assist in resolving procurement-related issues, including supplier delays, specification discrepancies, order changes, and delivery problems. Perform any other procurement-related duties and responsibilities assigned by the Supervisor or Management from time to time.

job_description: Job Summary Responsible for planning, implementing, and monitoring comprehensive safety, security, emergency response, fire safety, access control, loss prevention, and security operations across the hospital. Job Duties & Responsibilities Manage and supervise the overall security function, including in-house and outsourced security personnel, ensuring proper deployment, duty rosters, shift schedules, discipline, attendance, uniform standards, performance monitoring, and compliance with company requirements. Develop and implement security plans, SOPs, post orders, emergency procedures, and contingency plans to ensure effective security operations and preparedness for incidents such as fire, evacuation, medical emergencies, natural disasters, and other critical situations. Monitor and maintain security systems and equipment, including CCTV surveillance, access-control systems, security alarms, fire alarms, emergency lighting, fire extinguishers, emergency exits, and other safety-related systems. Coordinate emergency response activities, including fire drills, evacuation exercises, emergency training, and coordination with Police, Fire Service, ambulance services, and relevant government authorities when required. Manage security operations during VIP visits, special events, high-profile patient cases, and critical situations to ensure smooth and secure execution. Train and develop security personnel on communication, discipline, emergency response, fire safety, first response, hospital security procedures, and service standards. Maintain security documentation and reporting systems, including security registers, incident reports, investigation records, CCTV records, and daily, weekly, and monthly security reports for management review. job_description: Dhaka Ahsania Mission (DAM)  is a National NGO with Consultative Status with UN ECOSOC and UNESCO. It works for social and spiritual development of the community. Founded with the motto of ‘Divine and Humanitarian Service’, over 67 years DAM has been serving the human community for improved living conditions enhancing people’s capacities to multi-dimensional field programs and inner potentials.  The Technical & Vocational Education & Training (TVET) sector of Dhaka Ahsania Mission (DAM) has playing a significant role in the field of skills development activities in Bangladesh. Since 1985 DAM has been offering variety of livelihood skills development training courses through vocational training institutes. The skills need of unskilled, unemployed, underemployed and retrenched laborers are being addressed through these skills training along with employment support services. There are seven vocational training institutes (VTIs) located at Dhaka, Gazipur and Jashore district. In those VTIs we are facilitating twelve different courses under readymade garments, informal economy, light engineering and construction sector. All TVET institutions are affiliated and accredited as Registered Training Organization (RTO) from Bangladesh Technical Education Board (BTEB) and prevailing to contribute in providing the services regarding Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) and implementing CBT&A and NTVQF system. Dhaka Ahsania Mission (DAM) Invites applications for the position of Team Leader, TVET for ongoing Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) Sector.   Location: Dhaka. Frequent field visit will be required. Responsibilities : Take a role in the process of developing and implementing strategies for benchmarking program quality thresholds and parameters to meet DAM`s vision and strategic goals; Maintain effective liaison/interaction with Local & International donors, Bangladesh Technical Education Board (BTEB), National Skills Development Authority (NSDA) relevant local government institutions, national and international agencies, NGOs, local stakeholders, and other relevant implementing partners of the TVET sector; Develop the capacity of project teams to meet key performance indicators; Organize, design and deploy periodic programmatic  performance review  tools such as evaluations, impact assessments and studies; Develop strategic partnerships with TVET Stakeholders and strategically influence Stakeholders for DAM TVET programs; Create a good impression among stakeholders and clients through branding DAM TVET; Standardize of all DAM TVET courses in line with NTVQF, BTEB and NSDA requirements; Design diversify TVET courses based on market needs; Develop online database and tracking system for the trainees and graduates; Guide VTI managers and ensure project implementation, contractual targets, compliance and client expectations; Ensure need-based monitoring, research and evaluation; Coordinate with the Finance and Operations unit to ensure that programs are capable of compiling, maintaining and reporting on the monthly, quarterly and annual program reports, statistics and deliverables; Develop and design project, review and revise budget, work plan and activities periodically as per DAM & donor requirements; Ensure job placement for all VII`s trainees; Design and develop the TVET and skills development programs of DAM; Direction to the organize and conduct training on CBTA national certificate level-IV for TVET teachers, trainers and assessors; Build the partnership with related industry, agencies and other organizations; Raise fund and resource mobilize for the TVET sector of DAM; Develop Competency standards, curriculums, competency-based learning materials, etc. TVET; Develop TVET business plan and 5 years growth plan for its sustainability; Promote learning and knowledge management through documentation and knowledge sharing around best practices and lessons learned; Follow all kinds of DAM Safeguarding policies specially Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Gender, Child Protection, Anti-Harassment and Code of Conduct; Perform other duties and responsibilities assigned by the authority; Eligibilities: Outstanding analytical and writing skills and proven ability to quickly   understand complex challenges and propose solutions in organized, articulate concept papers, reports, and proposals; Sensitive to local and national development and clear understanding of the TVET Sector development in Bangladesh; Skills of developing curriculum, manual on different trades; Prepare Project Proposals for mobilization of human, technical or financial resources as project demand; Excellent oral and written communication skills; familiarity with MSWord, Excel, Power Point; Excellent organizational skills with a willingness to assume responsibilities and take initiative; ability to be a team player; Sector expertise/subject matter knowledge essential and should have good industry linkages; Certificate in CBTA NC level-iv and level-v will be added an advantage.

job_description: Job Context Rahman Group of Industries is a diversified industrial group in Rajshahi, with interests in jute spinning, cold storage, agro-commodities and transport. The Group is presently installing rooftop solar photovoltaic plants totalling approximately 5,100 kWp across seven of its industrial facilities, under a single turnkey EPC contract, with net metering to the national grid. We are looking for an experienced electrical engineer to act as the Group's own technical authority on this programme. The role is purely technical. The successful candidate will supervise the EPC contractor's work on site, verify that what is installed matches the approved design and specification, witness all testing and commissioning, and afterwards take charge of operating and maintaining the plants and keeping their generation at the guaranteed level. After the solar plants are commissioned, the role continues as the Group's in-house electrical engineer, responsible for the solar assets together with the electrical installations of the cold stores and spinning mills. Job Responsibilities During installation and commissioning Represent the Group on site during the installation of rooftop solar plants and act as its technical focal point with the EPC contractor. Check incoming materials against the approved technical specification — modules, inverters, DC and AC cable, mounting structure, cable tray, protection devices — and record and report any deviation in make, model, rating or quantity. Review and comment on the contractor's shop drawings, single line diagrams, string layouts, earthing and lightning protection drawings, structural layouts and cable schedules before work proceeds. Supervise day-to-day workmanship: module mounting and clamping, structure anchoring and roof waterproofing, DC string routing and labelling, cable tray installation, inverter mounting, earthing continuity and surge protection. Witness and record all pre-commissioning and commissioning tests, including insulation resistance, earth resistance, string open-circuit voltage and polarity, inverter parameter settings, protection settings and relay coordination. Attend the metering and net-metering inspection by the distribution utility and by SREDA. Verify plant performance at commissioning against the contracted Performance Ratio, review the measured data, and report the findings to management in writing. Prepare and maintain a complete technical dossier for each site — approved drawings, as-built drawings, test records, equipment serial numbers, warranty certificates, O&M manuals and commissioning reports. Maintain a site-by-site defect and snag register during construction and confirm in writing when each item has been rectified. Prepare monthly generation and performance reports comparing actual output against the design estimate and the guaranteed Performance Ratio, with reasons for any shortfall. Plan and supervise preventive maintenance — module cleaning cycles, thermal inspection of joints and terminations, torque checks, inverter servicing, earthing tests, structure inspection and drainage clearance. Attend to breakdowns, carry out first-line fault diagnosis, and raise and pursue warranty claims with the EPC contractor and the equipment manufacturers within the warranty periods. Train and supervise the site technicians and cleaning crew, and prepare simple written operating procedures for them. General electrical responsibility for the Group Monitor power factor, energy consumption and demand, and identify practical measures to reduce electricity cost. Submit the full Business Plan according to the agreed schedule based on the projected Soft Opening Date. Operations (Pre-Opening) Submit monthly Pre-Opening Reports covering updated activities and critical path items. Prepare detailed Operating Supplies and Equipment (OS&E) lists for costing and owner approval. Obtain Quality Hospitality Limited approval for all key items including uniforms, restaurant and facility names, logos, tabletops, Executive Committee positions, room types, and rate matrix. Develop Executive Committee and staff contracts in accordance with Quality Hospitality Limited guidelines. Ensure all Standard Operating Procedure manuals are completed at least 12 weeks prior to Soft Opening and submitted for Owner’s approval. Guarantee that every aspect of the hotel is fully prepared for Soft Opening, including successful completion of test dining and test stays. Post-Opening Strategic & Operational Leadership Develop and implement business strategies for the hotel that are fully aligned with Quality Hospitality Limited’s overall mission, vision, values, and strategies. Monitor progress regularly and adjust strategies as required. Ensure continuous alignment of hotel operations with owners’ and owning company objectives by serving as the key liaison for owner relations. Develop the annual business plan and capital budget in conjunction with the Financial Controller and Department Heads, and assist in obtaining owner approval. Collaborate with other entities within the Quality Group to leverage resources, purchases, revenues, and training opportunities. Achieve the hotel’s profit, customer service, and revenue goals by directing overall hotel operations. Maximize revenue by developing and implementing comprehensive sales and marketing plans. Seek opportunities to publicize the hotel through a structured public relations strategy and by building a strong local network. Work with the Executive Team to continuously improve hotel operations by evaluating guest services and responding to market opportunities. Analyze business results regularly and take decisive action to improve performance. Continuously monitor forward projections and communicate any variances promptly to Quality Hospitality Limited. Leverage system-wide expertise and resources to incorporate best practices and deliver services cost-effectively. Identify opportunities to grow occupancy, RevPAR, and market share by continuously researching competitor strategies. Work cooperatively with the Executive Committee to maintain high-level operational and financial control. Provide guidance through accurate financial analysis and direction. Assure compliance with internal controls and check charts. Investigate and resolve any problems arising in the reporting of hotel operations. Perform audits to verify that systems are working accurately. Analyze variances to budget in operating statements and make appropriate recommendations. Ensure monthly cost and expense audits are carried out. Identify operational inefficiencies and propose solutions to the Owning Company. Authorize accounting-related documents according to Owning Company policies. Optimize cash flow in accordance with established policies. Ensure compliance with all applicable government laws, rules, and regulations, including timely preparation and filing of tax and license returns. Oversee collection of accounts receivable. Maintain accurate files on all contractual obligations of the hotel. Direct the preparation of any information required by Owners. Ensure compliance with daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting requirements. Ensure monthly and quarterly balance sheet reconciliations are completed. Direct the preparation of check charts, credit reports, month-end reports, and monthly P&L statements. Assist all departments in budget preparation. Incorporate guest satisfaction into staff/operations meetings with emphasis on continuous improvement. Set clear goals and expectations for direct reports through the performance review process and hold staff accountable. Solicit employee feedback, maintain an open-door policy, and review employee satisfaction results to address concerns. Ensure property policies are administered fairly and consistently, and that disciplinary procedures follow Standard and Local Operating Procedures. Support the Peer Review Process. Conduct annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures. Champion change, ensure Owning Company business initiatives are implemented, and communicate follow-up actions to the team. Conduct both routine and short-notice quality assurance audits with specific departments. Hold employees accountable for performing regular audits. job_description: Lead and manage  24×7 Network Operations Center (NOC)  activities to ensure maximum network availability, service stability, and SLA compliance. Monitor, operate, and maintain  ISP backbone, core, edge, FTTH, GPON/EPON, enterprise, and branch networks . Configure, manage, troubleshoot, and optimize  MikroTik routers , including routing, firewall, NAT, QoS, VLAN, bandwidth management, and related network services. Configure and maintain  managed switches , including VLAN, trunk/access ports, STP/RSTP, LACP, port isolation, link aggregation, and other Layer-2 features. Monitor and manage  upstream connectivity , including bandwidth utilization, latency, packet loss, route quality, and service availability. Monitor, configure, and troubleshoot  BGP sessions  with upstream providers, IXs/NIXs, peers, and other network partners. Analyze BGP routes, prefixes, routing policies, path selection, route advertisements, and inbound/outbound traffic behavior. Coordinate with upstream providers, IX/NIX operators, vendors, and partners during connectivity issues, routing incidents, maintenance, and capacity upgrades. Design, review, document, and implement  network topology and architecture  for backbone, aggregation, distribution, access, FTTH, and branch networks. Plan and implement network expansion, redundancy, failover, capacity upgrades, and infrastructure optimization. Lead major incident management, advanced troubleshooting, service restoration, and  Root Cause Analysis (RCA)  for critical network incidents. Act as the  final technical escalation point  for major network, routing, connectivity, latency, packet-loss, and service-impacting issues. Manage and guide  NOC Engineers, Team Leads, and Branch Office technical teams , including shift planning, task distribution, technical support, and performance evaluation. Coordinate closely with  Core Network, Transmission, System, Security, Field Operations, Customer Support, upstream providers, IXs/NIXs, and vendors . Monitor network infrastructure using tools such as  LibreNMS, Zabbix, Cacti, SmokePing , and other network monitoring and alerting platforms. Proactively monitor  bandwidth utilization, link status, CPU/memory usage, interface errors, optical levels, latency, packet loss, routing changes, and network availability . Analyze monitoring data and traffic trends to identify potential bottlenecks, capacity limitations, or network degradation before they impact customers. Ensure timely execution and proper coordination of  planned maintenance, emergency maintenance, link migration, equipment replacement, and network upgrade activities . Maintain accurate  network diagrams, IP documentation, topology maps, device inventories, configuration records, SOPs, incident reports, RCA reports, and operational KPIs . Ensure proper configuration backup and documentation for routers, switches, and other critical network devices. Develop and improve  NOC processes, escalation procedures, monitoring standards, troubleshooting workflows, and operational SOPs . Provide technical mentoring and training to NOC and network team members to improve troubleshooting and operational capability. Work proactively to improve  network uptime, redundancy, routing efficiency, latency, packet-loss performance, and overall customer experience . Perform any other responsibilities assigned by the supervisor related to  NOC, network operations, infrastructure, routing, or ISP service management .

Job Summary: We are looking for a  Senior Executive/ Executive – Internal Audit  to conduct branch and operational audits across the country. The role will be responsible for assessing internal controls, verifying inventory and financial transactions, identifying risks and irregularities, and ensuring compliance with company policies and SOPs. Key Responsibilities: A. Branch Audit Execution (Field Work – 12–15 Days/Month) Conduct comprehensive branch audits and physical visits across the country. Plan and execute branch audit engagements, including evaluating compliance with company policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and internal control mechanisms. Identify control weaknesses, financial risks, errors, and potential fraud. Perform regular and surprise inventory audits of work-in-progress (WIP), finished goods, and spare parts. Verify physical stock against ERP/system records and investigate stock variances. Audit cash, bank, purchase, sales, payment, receipt, and journal vouchers, ensuring proper supporting documents are in place. Reconcile physical stock, ERP inventory records, and accounting ledgers. Monitor slow-moving, non-moving, damaged, and obsolete inventory. B. Office Work, Reporting and Documentation (Office Work – Remaining Days) Review invoices, bills, purchase orders (POs), goods receipt notes (GRNs), challans, requisitions, approvals, payment vouchers (PVs), journal vouchers (JVs), and other relevant documents. Verify purchase quantities, rates, vendor invoices, and approved purchase orders. Examine material receiving, issuing, transferring, returning, and consumption transactions. Validate production inputs, outputs, material consumption, and factory wastage. Analyze actual consumption against standard consumption and highlight unusual variances. Check ERP entries, ledger postings, journal entries, and account heads for accuracy. Identify duplicate, unsupported, unauthorized, or irregular transactions. Prepare Audit Observation Reports detailing findings, associated risks, and actionable recommendations. Follow up on previous audit observations to ensure that corrective actions are implemented. Prepare regular audit reports and present findings to the Head of Department (HOD). Maintain comprehensive audit documentation and organized working papers. Analyze audit data to identify trends, patterns, and areas of concern. C. Coordination and Communication Coordinate with Accounts, Finance, Operations, Procurement, Store, and other departments throughout the audit process. Communicate audit findings clearly to branch management and relevant stakeholders. Provide regular updates to the Senior Manager, Internal Audit, on audit progress and key findings.

 ১. পদের সারসংক্ষেপ 
 কমি শেফ কিচেন টিমের একটি প্রাথমিক কিন্তু গুরুত্বপূর্ণ পদ, যেখানে কর্মরত ব্যক্তি শেফ দ্য পার্টি, সু শেফ এবং হেড শেফের তত্ত্বাবধানে খাদ্য প্রস্তুত, উপকরণ প্রস্তুতকরণ এবং কিচেনের দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রম পরিচালনায় সহায়তা করবেন। 
 এই পদের মূল উদ্দেশ্য হলো প্রতিষ্ঠানের নির্ধারিত মান, রেসিপি এবং স্বাস্থ্যবিধি অনুসরণ করে খাদ্য প্রস্তুতির প্রাথমিক ধাপগুলো সম্পন্ন করা, কিচেনের কার্যক্রমকে সুশৃঙ্খল রাখা এবং সিনিয়র শেফদের কাজে সহায়তা করা। 
 
 ২. প্রধান দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য 
 ক) খাদ্য প্রস্তুতি সহায়তা 
 
 শেফদের নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী বিভিন্ন খাদ্য উপকরণ প্রস্তুত করা (কাটা, ধোয়া, পরিমাপ করা ইত্যাদি)। 
 নির্ধারিত রেসিপি অনুযায়ী খাদ্য প্রস্তুতির প্রাথমিক ধাপে সহায়তা করা। 
 খাবারের গুণগত মান বজায় রাখতে সতর্কতা অবলম্বন করা। 
 খাবারের সঠিক উপস্থাপন নিশ্চিত করতে সহায়তা করা। 
 
 খ) কিচেন পরিচালনা ও পরিচ্ছন্নতা 
 
 কিচেনের নির্ধারিত কর্মস্থল পরিষ্কার, স্বাস্থ্যসম্মত ও সুশৃঙ্খল রাখা। 
 রান্নাঘরের যন্ত্রপাতি, সরঞ্জাম ও উপকরণ ব্যবহারের পর পরিষ্কার রাখা। 
 স্বাস্থ্যবিধি ও খাদ্য নিরাপত্তা নীতিমালা মেনে চলা। 
 
 গ) উপকরণ ব্যবস্থাপনা 
 
 খাদ্য উপকরণ সঠিকভাবে সংরক্ষণ ও ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করা। 
 উপকরণের সতেজতা ও গুণগত মান পরীক্ষা করা। 
 প্রয়োজনীয় উপকরণের ঘাটতি হলে সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্তৃপক্ষকে অবহিত করা। 
 
 ঘ) টিমওয়ার্ক ও সহযোগিতা 
 
 কিচেন টিমের অন্যান্য সদস্যদের সাথে সমন্বয় রেখে কাজ করা। 
 সিনিয়র শেফদের নির্দেশনা অনুসরণ করা এবং তাদের কাজে সহায়তা করা। 
 ব্যস্ত সময়ে দ্রুত ও দক্ষতার সাথে কাজ সম্পন্ন করা। 
 
 
 ৩. প্রয়োজনীয় যোগ্যতা ও দক্ষতা 
 
 কুলিনারি আর্টস বা ফুড প্রোডাকশন বিষয়ে প্রশিক্ষণ থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। 
 রেস্টুরেন্ট, ক্যাফে বা হোটেল কিচেনে  কমপক্ষে ১–২ বছরের অভিজ্ঞতা  থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার। 
 খাদ্য প্রস্তুতি, রান্নার মৌলিক কৌশল এবং কিচেন ব্যবস্থাপনা সম্পর্কে প্রাথমিক ধারণা। 
 স্বাস্থ্যবিধি ও খাদ্য নিরাপত্তা নিয়ম সম্পর্কে সচেতনতা। 
 দলগতভাবে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা এবং দায়িত্বশীল মনোভাব। 
 দ্রুত শেখার আগ্রহ এবং পেশাদারিত্ব বজায় রাখার মানসিকতা। 
 
 
 ৪. কর্মপরিবেশ ও কর্মঘণ্টা 
 
 রান্নাঘরের পরিবেশে দীর্ঘ সময় দাঁড়িয়ে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা থাকতে হবে। 
 প্রয়োজনে শিফট ভিত্তিক কাজ, সপ্তাহান্তে বা বিশেষ দিনে কাজ করতে হতে পারে। 
 
 
 ৫. বেতন ও সুবিধা 
 
 প্রার্থীর যোগ্যতা ও অভিজ্ঞতার ভিত্তিতে প্রতিষ্ঠানের নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী বেতন নির্ধারণ করা হবে। 
 প্রতিষ্ঠানের নিয়ম অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য সুবিধা প্রদান করা হবে।
